definitions.explanation: Fine particles of rock and mineral fragments ejected from a volcano during an eruption.

examples.japanese: {火山灰|かざんばい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っている→降る：00839_furu⟧。
⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと、⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{火山灰|かざんばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覆|おお}われた→覆う：02020_oou⟧。
examples.english: After the eruption, the town was covered in volcanic ash.

examples.japanese: {鹿児島|かごしま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{桜島|さくらじま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{火山灰|かざんばい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日常的|にちじょうてき}→日常的：16902_nichijouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{慣|な}れている→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧。
examples.english: In Kagoshima, volcanic ash from Sakurajima falls regularly, so residents are accustomed to dealing with it.

notes:
{火山灰|かざんばい} refers to fine particles of rock ejected during a volcanic eruption. A compound of ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧ (volcano) + ⟦{灰|はい}→灰：02244_hai⟧ (ash). The reading uses {灰|ばい}, the on'yomi.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火山灰|かざんばい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: volcanic ash falls
- {火山灰|かざんばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覆|おお}われる→覆う：02020_oou⟧: to be covered in volcanic ash
- {火山灰|かざんばい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧: to remove volcanic ash
- {火山灰|かざんばい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{積|つ}もる→積もる：01964_tsumoru⟧: volcanic ash accumulates

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has many active volcanoes, so {火山灰|かざんばい} is a practical concern. In {鹿児島|かごしま}, {桜島|さくらじま} regularly deposits ash, and special collection bags ({克灰袋|こくはいぶくろ}) are distributed by the city.
